meta.fitted_on: train split 0 only: 431 markets (5m 248, 15m 146, 4h 37), opens 2026-08-21..22 UTC; Binance < 2026-08-23

settlement.note: price_to_beat (Chainlink) = K_binance * exp(open_basis); sim settles Up iff TWAP60_binance(end) * exp(eps) >= K_binance, eps ~ N(0, sigma_basis^2) (0 in the base sim)

5m.note: target = s_fast*logit(p) + (s_slow-s_fast)*EWMA_hl(logit p) + b(tau) + u, u AR(1) (half-life halflife_u_s, innovation sd sigma_u); the book re-aligns to the target only at update events (prob update_prob[tau_b] per second) and holds otherwise

15m.note: target = s_fast*logit(p) + (s_slow-s_fast)*EWMA_hl(logit p) + b(tau) + u, u AR(1) (half-life halflife_u_s, innovation sd sigma_u); the book re-aligns to the target only at update events (prob update_prob[tau_b] per second) and holds otherwise

4h.note: target = s_fast*logit(p) + (s_slow-s_fast)*EWMA_hl(logit p) + b(tau) + u, u AR(1) (half-life halflife_u_s, innovation sd sigma_u); the book re-aligns to the target only at update events (prob update_prob[tau_b] per second) and holds otherwise

regime.note: P(one-sided) = table[len, tau_b, ext_b(p_model)][2]; P(hollow | not one-sided) = hollow_given_not_onesided[len, coin_group, tau_b]; per market Gaussian-copula AR(1) thresholds give the persistence (copula half-lives fitted to P(S_t=S|S_t-1=S)); one-sided removes the side beyond the extreme (ask if p_model > 0.5)

size.note: log size ~ N(mu[level], sd[level]); redrawn at update events as AR(1) with rho = (acf1 - (1 - pi_update)) / pi_update so the per-second autocorrelation matches

book_change_profile.note: P(book_age == 0) per (len, tau_b) in train ticks

size_library.keep_prob_note: at an update event the previous vector is kept with prob 1 - (1 - acf1)/pi_update, else a fresh one is drawn

glm.note: lambda_t = A_m * exp(tau_cell[len,tau_b] + b_absgap*min(|p-mid|,0.3) + b_absz5*min(|z5|,6) + b_onesided*O) + hawkes_eta * H_t,  H_t = d*H_{t-1} + (1-d)*n_{t-1}, d = exp(-1/hawkes_tau); baseline shape from a Poisson GLM with market fixed effects, (eta, tau) and A_m by profile MLE; covariates at match time (block time - 3 s); lambda = 0 in the hollow state

market_effect.note: log A_m = a_len + a_coin + N(0, sd^2) (Hawkes baseline scale per market)

direction.note: P(taker buys Up | p_model - mid at match time); with prob rho_copy a trade repeats the previous trade's direction in that market; rho_copy_by_len re-set after the look-ahead fix (calibrate_env.py copy5m)

size_log_quantiles.note: log taker size quantiles by length and by 'length|coin group' (the engine uses the coin-group version)

sweep.note: taker limit allows j extra levels beyond the best (j ~ p_extra_levels); size is capped at the displayed depth within the limit; each level touched yields a geometric number of maker legs

tokens.note: probability that a leg is on the Up token, by aggressor direction (Up frame); Down legs carry price 1-p and the opposite side

stamp_delay.note: block time - match time (COVERAGE.md: alignment with the book peaks at 3-4 s); a fitted delay mixture could not reproduce the real alignment curve (see VALIDATION.md)

informed.note: P(buy) = (1-w) * P_fit(buy | gap) + w * 1[staleness > 0], staleness = sigmoid(target + v) - displayed latent mid (what the next book update reveals); w and the impact kappa by grid search on simulated markout drift + P(buy|gap) curve (train)

impact.note: each print adds kappa * sign * sqrt(min(size, 500)/10) to an impact accumulator a (logit units, decays with half-life halflife_s); the mid target carries v, which approaches a with half-life rise_halflife_s

lookahead_calibration.note: calibrate_env.py: one train-schedule replication per candidate through features.py + C env; loss on baseline markout curves, fill volume, capture, totals, print alignment, trade counts

followup.note: 5m look-ahead kappa lowered to 0.5 and copy prob 0 (5m) / 0.1 (15m) so the sign ACF of trades matches real (look-ahead informed trades already come in same-sign runs)

randomization.note: per market (episode), applied only with --randomize; uniform unless 'log' (log-uniform)

informed_share.doc: share of takers trading on the sign of the mid's staleness (fitted value per length in flow.informed.w)

lookahead_mult.doc: scales the look-ahead informed-taker sensitivity kappa (flow.lookahead)

hawkes_eta.doc: branching ratio; the baseline is rescaled by (1-eta)/(1-eta_fit) to keep the mean rate

sigma_basis_mult.doc: base sim uses 0 (pure Binance settlement proxy)
